crossRefs.note: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid, and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with…
The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maiden; and she…
He prepared a great feast for them. When they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So…
The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah…

people.name: Baanah
people.line: A captain who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

people.name: Beeroth
people.line: Hivite city, later allotted to Benjamin.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Rechab
people.line: A captain of Ishbosheth's army, with his brother Baanah

people.name: Rimmon
people.line: Father of Baanah and Rechab, murderers of Ish-bosheth

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin:
translations.bsb: Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding parties. One was named Baanah and the other Rechab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
translations.kjv: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
translations.asv: And Ish-bosheth, Saul's son, had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is reckoned to Benjamin:
